feed.title: Verilay Patchmap: Printing and scanning
feed.subtitle: Known problems and monthly security updates for Windows, from Verilay Patchmap. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

entry.title: Not fixed yet: Printing fails for documents with zero-size images
entry.summary: Printing can fail when a document contains an image with zero height or width at the selected resolution. These images can be invisible. Mainly Word documents printed through GDI, but other apps can be affected. Confirmed by Microsoft. No fix date announced. Affects: Windows 11 24H2, Windows 11 25H2, Windows 11 26H2, Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2025, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016. Source: https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/15/microsoft-confirms-november-windows-updates-cause-activation-error-0x80041008-and-printing-failures/. From Patchmap (news and vendor reports).
